english.title: Take down / alter / remove a barrier / traffic sign / support / light erected / fence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse,

(A)_[took down]_
(B)_[altered]_
(C)_[removed]_

a

(D)_[barrier erected or placed in pursuance of section 174(1) of the Highways Act 1980]_
(E)_[traffic sign erected or placed in pursuance of section 174(1) of the Highways Act 1980]_
(F)_[support erected or placed in pursuance of section 174(1) of the Highways Act 1980]_
(G)_[light erected or placed in pursuance of section 174(1) of the Highways Act 1980]_
(H)_[fence erected or placed on or near a street, namely **(..SPECIFY STREET..) in pursuance of enactment, namely **(..SPECIFY ENACTMENT OTHER THAN SECTION 174(1) OF THE HIGHWAYS ACT 1980..)]_
(I)_[barrier erected or placed on or near a street, namely **(..SPECIFY STREET..) in pursuance of enactment, namely **(..SPECIFY ENACTMENT OTHER THAN SECTION 174(1) OF THE HIGHWAYS ACT 1980..)]_
(J)_[traffic sign erected or placed on or near a street, namely **(..SPECIFY STREET..) in pursuance of enactment, namely **(..SPECIFY ENACTMENT OTHER THAN SECTION 174(1) OF THE HIGHWAYS ACT 1980..)]_
(K)_[light erected or placed on or near a street, namely **(..SPECIFY STREET..) in pursuance of enactment, namely **(..SPECIFY ENACTMENT OTHER THAN SECTION 174(1) OF THE HIGHWAYS ACT 1980..)]_

for the purpose of warning users of the street of an obstruction or of protecting them from danger arising out of such an obstruction
english.legislation: Contrary to section 174(4)(a) of the Highways Act 1980.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Proceedings for this offence shall not without the written consent of the Attorney General, be taken by any person other than the person aggrieved, or a highway authority or council having an interest in the enforcement of the provision or byelaws in question - section 312 Highways Act 1980.
(ii) The meaning of "highway" is defined in section 328 Highways Act 1980.
